interface.shortDescription: Prepare to write in your own words
interface.longDescription: Research and organize a writer’s packet while preserving human authorship. Provides evidence, sources, questions, counterarguments, and structure. Drafts or rewrites only on explicit request. Inspired by Thomas Ptacek’s How To Write With An LLM.
